proof_scope: Visual reviewer evidence gate for Tau creator-reviewer DAGs

claims.proves: Tau blocks fake visual reviewer PASS receipts that claim represents_goal/attractive without screenshot-bound evidence, blocks screenshot-only reviewer JSON without a separate path-backed visual_review_receipt, and accepts the equivalent reviewer verdict when the PNG screenshot path, screenshot sha256, mocked/live fields, and visual_review_receipt are present and validated.
claims.does_not_prove: Human aesthetic acceptance, provider semantic quality, React Flow rendering, or GOAL.md completion.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Tau creator-reviewer DAGs reject visual-quality reviewer PASS claims unless the reviewer verdict is bound to a readable PNG screenshot path, exact sha256, mocked/live proof boundary, and a separate path-backed visual_review_receipt validated by Tau.
